text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. And that is the end of that.
choice_data_list:
Great work! You really gave it your all 
today.

Great work! You really gave it everything 
today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes, naturally.

A few days after visiting the Club and 
finding her answer— 
Phalaenopsis was back in top form.
choice_data_list:
At this rate, the Victoria Mile will be no 
problem.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Your seal of approval, is it? 
Heh... That is heartening to hear.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Then let us go, Trainer. 
To let the azure skies hear my cry of 
victory.

Seeing Phalaenopsis back to her usual 
self, 
I secretly breathed a sigh of relief. A 
swell of passion 
unwittingly welled up inside me as well.
choice_data_list: I can't wait to see you forge the future!

I'm looking forward to watching you carve 
out that future!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Sit back and watch. 
I shall bring the Club's future...—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...No, I see now. "Forge the future." 
I was so captivated by the idea of 
bringing 
a future to the Club all by myself, but—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
What I truly must do is "forge the 
future." 
By securing GⅠ victories and becoming a 
cornerstone of prosperity—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And beyond that—together with those who 
follow. 
We shall polish the Club into the "Most 
Beautiful Garden."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is in that very dawn where the garden I 
long for resides.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...There was never any need to make it a 
perfect flower garden 
with my own hands alone. I had somehow 
forgotten that.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Our journey ahead holds nothing but 
promise.

And so, the day of the Victoria Mile 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Body temperature normal. Clear 
visibility toward my cherished ambition. 
My legs thrum with energy, and a roaring 
fire is lit within my heart.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Rock-solid.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can kindle a fire in even 
more young fillies. 
I can inspire fresh green shoots to join 
our Club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I can achieve what only I am capable of 
doing.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Is that not so?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, exactly. It's something only you can 
do.

Yes, exactly. It's something only you can 
do.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... My thanks. You were the one 
who truly made me realize that.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Bearing this torch, from this moment on, 
I shall become a gust of wind to captivate 
rising stars.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Please, take pride in this.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: The credit belongs to you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, splendid. 
The sky is so clearly visible today.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I see now just how narrow 
my vision was during the Yomiuri Milers 
Cup.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(—Guided by my Trainer, my horizon has 
opened. 
With an expanse this vast and clear...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The final stretch. 
How effortlessly I shall leave them 
behind.
